provider: Contabo Storage VPS — unlimited traffic, 300 GB–1.4 TB

free_tier.stated: Storage VPS 10: 300 GB SSD (150 GB NVMe option), 2 vCPU / 4 GB RAM, €5.50/mo for the first 24 months. Top tier 1.4 TB SSD at €37/mo. Higher tiers listed as 'More storage available'.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: No retention clause documented in available terms.

egress.terms: Unmetered. Quoted verbatim: 'Unlimited Traffic* … Unlimited outgoing and unlimited inbound data transfer with 200 Mbit/s to 1 Gbit/s speeds. Fair usage policies apply.' This is the single most useful egress term in the slot: no byte meter, only a port-speed ceiling and a FUP.

tooling: Root KVM. SSH/SFTP/rsync/rclone. No object API.
chaining: No free tier. But 'unlimited traffic + capacity-priced' means the composition move is a single large instance rather than many free ones: 1.4 TB unmetered for €37/mo beats ten free tiers that all clamp.
limits_note: Network port is 200 Mbit/s on entry tiers under fair use policies. Setup fees apply on select billing terms.
reliability_note: Hostloc thread evidence: a user running Contabo at 3 TB says '现在用的contabo已经只剩1.4t了'. Capacity creep on a shared storage volume is the reported failure mode, not deletion. Widely used, oversold reputation.
confidence_note: Unverified: carried from historical research records without live verification. A first-party page read confirms documentation.
